title: Reflection through the specified completed pullback unit
statement: For the adic datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and every scheme morphism u:U→V, the ambient completed pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] has quotient-tower complete output on every input K. For every quotient-tower complete L on U, precomposition with the specified ordinary-to-completed unit j_u(K) gives a bijection Hom(F_u K,L)→Hom(Lu* K,L).

source.place: Tag 099N, lemma-functoriality-derived-completion, proof of (2),(5); Tag 099M; strict K-flat quotient construction. Source mathematical argument is also written in the declaration docstring.

proof.text: Transport the constant-site quotient completion reflector through completed_constant_presentation_transport. For each ambient K its quotient comparison q identifies F(comp_K) followed by q with the actual constant-site unit. Full faithfulness therefore identifies invertibility of comp_K with intrinsic completeness. Completeness of the constant reflector output and naturality of its unit along q prove completeness of every ambient quotient completion. Its Hom bijection transports back by full faithfulness, precomposing with q inverse.

Use stratumReductionIso for the arbitrary scheme morphism u; this comparison and its augmentation theorem have no stratum-restriction hypothesis. Apply completedRlim to this strict tower isomorphism. Its augmentation equation, together with cancellation of the derivedConstantPullbackIso inverse/hom pair, identifies ordinaryToCompleted followed by this isomorphism with completionUnit at ordinary pullback. Completeness is invariant under the isomorphism by naturality of the completion unit. Transport the quotient-reflector Hom bijection along this same isomorphism: injectivity cancels its inverse, and surjectivity postcomposes the lifted arrow with its hom.

theorem AdicCoefficientDatum.completedPull_reflection {U V : Scheme.{t}} (u : U ⟶ V) :
    (∀ K : d.derived V, d.TowerComplete U ((d.completedPull u).obj K)) ∧
      ∀ (K : d.derived V) (L : d.derived U), d.TowerComplete U L →
        Function.Bijective (fun a : (d.completedPull u).obj K ⟶ L ↦
          d.ordinaryToCompleted u K ≫ a)
